name: What is the typical timeframe for a home remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a home remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for a home remodeling project varies significantly based on its scope and complexity. A small bathroom remodel might take a few weeks, while a major kitchen renovation or whole-home remodel can extend to several months. Factors like design approvals, material availability, and unforeseen structural issues can also impact the schedule. Frasheski Construction works to establish a clear project timeline upfront and communicates any adjustments promptly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; small remodels can take weeks, while larger projects may take several months. Scope, materials, and unforeseen issues affect duration.
